name: Epöl (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Epöl: a crowned green and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a patriarchal cross and a church, above a scroll inscribed EPÖL.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
